parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The first law of thermodynamics can be represented by the expression

$$\Delta U = q + w.$$

State what is meant by the symbols in the expression.

+$\Delta U$ = ................................

+$q$ = ................................

+$w$ = ................................

+w

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
A fixed mass of an ideal gas undergoes a cycle ABCA of changes, as shown in Fig. 2.1.

{{figure:figure_2_1.png}}

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
During the change from A to B, the energy supplied to the gas by heating is $442\text{ J}$.
Use the first law of thermodynamics to show that the internal energy of the gas increases by $265\text{ J}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
During the change from B to C, the internal energy of the gas decreases by $313\text{ J}$.
By considering molecular energy, state and explain qualitatively the change, if any, in the temperature of the gas.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: For the change from C to A, use the data in (b)(i) and (b)(ii) to calculate the change in internal energy.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: The temperature of the gas at point A is $227^{\circ}\text{C}$. Calculate the number of molecules in the fixed mass of the gas.
